source.market_name: Will Ukraine agree to give up the rest of Donbas by December 31, 2026?

market_name: Will Ukraine agree to give up the rest of Donbas by December 31, 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether Polymarket odds move is corroborated by any wire headlines (Reuters/Bloomberg) on talks; confirm EPOL pre-market/intraday is not just tracking broad EM beta.
time_plan.1h: Compare EPOL move vs EEM/broad EM to isolate Ukraine-specific component; watch EUR and Polish zloty for confirmation.
time_plan.2h: Reassess if any official Ukrainian/Russian denial emerges, which would reverse the premium compression.
time_plan.6h: Check European defense names and natural gas for corroborating de-escalation signal; fade if no cross-asset confirmation.
time_plan.12h: Mark final EPOL return vs EM benchmark; log whether move persisted or reversed and whether any public news eventually surfaced.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability that Ukraine cedes the rest of Donbas would signal real progress toward a negotiated settlement/ceasefire. Peace de-risks frontline-adjacent economies; Poland, the most exposed liquid EM-Europe proxy, typically rallies on de-escalation news as regional war-risk premium compresses and reconstruction/trade optimism rises. EPOL is liquid and directly geared to Russia-Ukraine tail risk.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify defense weakness coincides with the odds shift and isn't broad-market risk-off; European defense (Rheinmetall) is more exposed but less liquid for us.
time_plan.1h: Check whether ITA underperforms S&P 500 specifically.
time_plan.2h: Reassess on any official denial or escalation that would reverse.
time_plan.6h: Cross-check with EPOL/natural gas direction for a coherent peace narrative.
time_plan.12h: Record final ITA relative return and note weak-proxy caveat.

predictions.reasoning: A credible Donbas-cession/peace signal reduces expectations of prolonged European rearmament demand and Ukraine-support spending, a modest headwind for defense names. However US defense spend is driven by many factors beyond Ukraine, so exposure is diluted and the proxy is weak; move likely small.

evidence_used: Market question concerns a diplomatic Donbas cession deal, i.e. a peace/ceasefire proxy for the Russia-Ukraine war
Peace/de-escalation historically compresses regional war-risk premia (Polish equities, EUR, gas) and softens European defense demand expectations
Long resolution horizon (end-2026) means a 12h probability jump is an early/soft signal, not a confirmed event
uncertainty_notes: A far-dated resolution means intraday odds moves may be noise or reflect low-liquidity Polymarket repricing, not genuine information leakage
Proxies are only loosely geared to this specific question; broad macro/EM beta can dominate the 12h window
A Yes-direction odds spike could equally be driven by pessimism about Ukraine's battlefield position rather than genuine diplomacy, muddying the equity-risk read

llm_justification.summary: This market is effectively a Russia-Ukraine peace/ceasefire proxy. A sharp rise in the odds of a Donbas-cession deal would plausibly compress regional war-risk premium—lifting liquid EM-Europe equity (EPOL) and modestly pressuring defense exposure (ITA)—but the resolution horizon is far (end-2026), proxies are diluted, and both effects are likely small and well below the 700bps tradable threshold over 12h. We flag this as a low-confidence, non-tradable mapping.
key_assumptions: A probability jump reflects genuine diplomatic-progress information rather than low-liquidity noise or battlefield pessimism
EPOL remains the cleanest liquid proxy for regional de-escalation
Defense demand expectations are at least partly tied to the Ukraine conflict
failure_modes: Move reverses within hours on official Ukrainian/Russian denial—peace headlines are frequently walked back
The information is already public (reported talks), so no asset edge remains
Proxies are weakly exposed: EPOL/ITA driven by global macro, dwarfing the Ukraine-specific signal
A Yes-odds spike could signal Ukrainian weakness/coercion rather than benign peace, which could be risk-off for the region and flip the sign
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
